title: WorkflowSnapshot
description: On-disk representation of the coordinare's current workflow position. Written atomically after every phase transition.

schema_version.description: Schema version. A value other than 1 indicates an incompatible prior version and must be discarded.

snapshot_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this snapshot was written.

phase.description: Current workflow phase at the time the snapshot was written.

active_card_id.description: Board item node ID of the active card. Null when phase is 'idle'.

active_card_title.description: Title of the active card. Null when phase is 'idle'.

active_card_column.description: Board column name (e.g. 'In Progress') at the time the snapshot was written. Null when phase is 'idle'.

pr_url.description: GitHub PR URL. Non-null in monitoring_pr, merging, relay_feedback phases.

pr_node_id.description: GitHub PR node ID. Non-null in monitoring_pr, merging, relay_feedback phases.

agent_session_id.description: Agent session identifier. Non-null in monitoring_agent and relay_feedback phases.

open_questions.description: Open questions pending team answers. Non-empty only in blocked phase.
